description: Edits a webhook in place; send only the fields you want to change. The trigger takes the filters of the subscribe that made the webhook (subscription_origin.type: scan q/universe/select/order/dir; ticker q/select; signal condition/universe/select/order/dir; event kind/ticker/universe/q/select; news search/ticker/universe/min_relevance/q/select), validated like a new subscribe; a change to the filters fires only on new matches (what already matches or already happened does not fire), while an edit of select/order/dir keeps what already matched. enabled=true turns a disabled webhook back on. Unknown fields are a 400.

cadence.description: Evaluation cadence. Event and news webhooks deliver as they land, so only `realtime` is accepted on them.

channel.description: Moves the webhook to another channel: `webhook` (with `target_url`), `discord` (with `discord_url`), `in_app` or `mobile_push` (with `device_id`). Inferred from `discord_url` or `device_id` when you send one of those alone.

condition.description: Only with signal webhooks. The bound, in Get a signal's grammar (`<30`).

device_id.description: Only with `channel=mobile_push`. Device to notify, from `POST /v2/devices/register`.

dir.description: Only with scan or signal webhooks. The sort direction for `order`.

discord_url.description: Only with `channel=discord`. Discord incoming-webhook URL. Never returned after this call: reads show `channel_config_present: true`.

enabled.description: `false` turns the webhook off. `true` turns a disabled webhook back on: your webhook limit is checked and the trigger is checked again. A plain re-enable starts clean and fires once for every current match; after a change to the trigger's filters (in this call or while it was off) it fires only on new matches.

kind.description: Only with event webhooks. The kinds to fire on, as on Subscribe to events. Values: dividend, split, insider, analyst, earnings, filing, estimate_revision.

min_relevance.description: Only with news webhooks. The least relevance (0–1) a scoped ticker needs; the webhook needs a `ticker` or `universe` scope.

name.description: New display name. Non-empty, max 80 characters.

order.description: Only with scan or signal webhooks. The signal each delivery's match lists are sorted by.

q.description: Only with scan, ticker, event or news webhooks. The filter, in the grammar of the subscribe that made the webhook. On an event webhook it replaces the whole filter. On a ticker webhook send the condition alone, or the `q` a read returns (`ticker = 'NVDA' AND (…)`): the webhook's own ticker scope is not added twice. A change to the filters (`q`, `condition`, `universe`, `kind`, `ticker`, `search`, `min_relevance`) fires only on new matches; an edit of `select`, `order` or `dir` keeps what already matched.

search.description: Only with news webhooks. The full-text search, as on Subscribe to news.

select.description: What each delivery carries, as on the subscribe that made the webhook; `null` for the default.

target_url.description: New https:// delivery URL. Alone, it moves a webhook between HTTPS (`target_url`) and in-app delivery (`null` or empty); a Discord or mobile-push webhook sends `channel: "webhook"` with it.

ticker.description: Only with event or news webhooks. The symbols, one or a comma list. Replaces a `universe` scope.

universe.description: Only with scan, signal, event or news webhooks. The universe to scope to; `null` for the whole market. On event and news webhooks it replaces a `ticker` scope.

name: tickerbot_update_webhook
